newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Moody's assigns A2/P-1 deposit ratings to BG Bank.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns A2/P-1 deposit ratings to BG Bank.

text.p: Credit ratings agency Moody's said on Tuesday it assigned A2/Prime-1 deposit ratings and a C financial strength rating to Denmark's Bikuben Girobank A/S, or BG Bank.
Moody's said in a statement the bank had yet to realise the full potential of a 1995 merger which created the bank and of planned co-operation agreements.
"Until these goals are fully achieved BG Bank may be in a weaker position than its competitors in the Danish banking market," Moody's said in the statement.

Moody's said it believed the bank, which is the third largest in Denmark, had good financial fundamentals. Asset quality and loan loss charges had been improving in recent years and were at satisfactory levels.
But Moody's said major work still needed to be done to bring to fruition the potential benefits of the merger and to consolidate the remaining co-operation agreements.
"These are major undertakings and until they are fully achieved, BG Bank may be in a weak position relative to its main Danish competitors in a highly consolidated banking market," Moody's said.
